versions.changelog: La skill puente ahora se llama f100k-puente

Initial release with comprehensive support for building and delivering Skool communities.

- Guides users through the full process of designing community offers, copy, and structure for Skool, including About Pages, onboarding, VSLs, forum setup, and more.
- Workflow is always in Spanish, with conversational prompts and step-by-step brief collection before writing.
- Supports both partial (About, description, posts, etc.) and full, final community proposals delivered in .docx (or .md if dependencies missing).
- Interacts via Telegram, sending questions and deliverables according to client responses, confirming existing data, and offering revisions.
- Never invents details; always confirms or requests missing info before generating content.
